description: A blue-covered bed surface holds a small stack of four plastic bowls in different colors near the front-right, with a pale pink sheet draped against the back. The left hand rests near the center while the right hand reaches in, grips the top light-purple bowl as a right-hand object, lifts it up and to the right to set it down separately, then lifts the next light-green bowl and places it to the left, and finally picks up a darker teal bowl and sets it down near the back-right, leaving the orange bowl in front.
